product.title: Hiking Experience in Bryce Canyon National Park

description.text: Hike through the canyons and amphitheaters of Bryce Canyon on this small group guided tour. Your guide will fill you in on local stories, explaining what “hoodoos” are, and showing you some of the most scenic spots to hike through- and photograph. Stops include Bryce Amphitheater. You’ll be provided with snacks and water along the way to keep you energized for the hike. Ideal for visitors basing near Bryce Canyon City who want a guided red-rock experience without coordinating park entrances, trailheads, or photo stops on their own.

highlights: Keep costs down by joining this small group tour
Granola bars and fruit provided for you
Tour for around 5 hours, then the rest of the day is free
